task.title: Add source/API contract drift checks
task.summary: Add source/API contract drift checks under the checks layer so code↔code and KB↔code drift can be detected before gateway review relies on manual inspection.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki has deterministic source/API contract check evidence that horizontal/gateway workflows can consume for public facades, tool registrations, and documented package surfaces.
acceptance: Contract snapshot captures tool names, command names, public API facade exports, and package entry surfaces relevant to CodeWiki behavior.
Checks compare current source contract to documented/expected contract and produce actionable diffs.
Snapshot tests cover wiki_* naming and prevent stale internal tool names from silently reappearing.
Contract generation is deterministic and not canonical truth unless explicitly accepted.
non_goals: Do not publish or version a public API package contract beyond local check evidence.
Do not snapshot implementation-private internals without documented ownership reason.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Contract snapshot captures tool names, command names, public API facade exports, and package entry surfaces relevant to CodeWiki behavior.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/checks/source-contract-snapshot.ts generates deterministic SourceContractSnapshot with tools, commands, api_exports, package files/pi/knip entry surfaces, source files, and digest; tests/smoke/source-contract.test.mjs asserts each surface is captured.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Checks compare current source contract to documented/expected contract and produce actionable diffs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/checks/source-contract.ts extracts documented tools/commands/package entries from README/api docs, compares them to the generated source snapshot, and emits explicit tool-contract/command-contract/package-entry/API-facade issues; tests cover pass and stale namespace failure cases.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Snapshot tests cover wiki_* naming and prevent stale internal tool names from silently reappearing.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/fixtures/source-contract/wiki-tools.expected.json and tests/smoke/source-contract.test.mjs define a wiki_state expected contract and assert a codewiki_state registration fails with tool-namespace-stale.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Contract generation is deterministic and not canonical truth unless explicitly accepted.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: generateSourceContractSnapshot has no timestamp or persisted snapshot output; tests assert two generated snapshots are deeply equal and that generated_at is absent.

closure_brief.user_intent: Proceed with TASK-052: add source/API contract drift checks under the checks layer.
implemented_changes: Added deterministic source/API contract snapshot generation.
Added source-contract audit profile comparing documented expected surfaces to current source contract.
Added tests covering snapshot surfaces, deterministic generation, and wiki_* stale-name failures.
Wired source-contract into audit profile dispatch, /audit command, docs, skills, and smoke tests.
remaining_risks: Source-contract expected surface extraction is README/API-doc based and intentionally narrow; deeper package API compatibility is a future extension, not this task.
Reload required after commit before Pi tool schema accepts source-contract profile via codewiki_audit.
